the fixture proving the widened seed fires, beside the lane's own assertion
the span-rendering cases the widened scan reports declare the shared budget

summary: a default-lane case whose subject is inline-exec spans starts a shell per span, inherits vitest's 5s default, and the budget scan is blind to it

per.section: The default test lane must stay fast

acceptance: the spawn scan reports a default-lane case that renders inline-exec spans, and every site it reports declares the shared budget.
tests: the spawn scan reports a case that renders inline-exec spans without a declared budget
notes: Observed: tests/examples.test.ts's unreadable-artifact case timed out at vitest's 5s under full-suite contention, ~650ms alone. `sh` is no node launcher and the scan never follows an import, so NODE_COMMANDS cannot reach it — seed the render entry the spans go through, declared where NODE_COMMANDS is. The afterMerge gate runs this lane once per cherry-picked entry, so the flake reverts an innocent entry.

edit.description: the inbox window's lane leg, beside the record and refusal legs
the reader reports the run's identity and whether it failed, for the leg to compare against the stamp
the slice stamps the run it drained, as it stamps a cursor
the lane leg over the stub forge CLI: red past the stamp, red already stamped, green, unreadable

summary: a declared lane never wakes the inbox slice, so a quiet tree hibernates over a red lane — and with no closing condition a woken lane would re-drain the same run every tick

per.section: CI lanes as a findings source

acceptance: the inbox slice is live for a declared lane exactly when that lane's latest completed run for the tip's branch failed and is past the lane's stamp; a green run, an already-stamped run, and a lane it cannot read each make it live for nothing.
tests: the inbox slice is live when a declared lane's latest completed run failed past the lane's stamp
the inbox slice is not live when the lane's failing run is the one already stamped
the inbox slice is not live when the lane's latest completed run passed
the inbox slice is not live when the forge CLI cannot read the lane
notes: `PlanSliceWindow.live` is sync and runs on the selection path (planState.ts), so the lane read has a sync half — once per tick per lane, beside the render's. The agent writes the stamp as it writes a cursor, so the rendered lane block must name the run it would stamp. `harness/ci.ts` is INBOX-SLICE-RENDERS-THE-DECLARED-CI-LANE's new file; this widens its report with the run's identity and verdict.
